gn.en.gn.adv-freq.note: Riječi poput usually, often i sometimes govore koliko je neka navika česta. Dolaze ispred glavnog glagola i iza be: "I usually walk. She is often late."
gn.en.gn.adv-freq.title: Prilozi učestalosti
gn.en.gn.art-the.note: "The" označava nešto što oboje znamo: "the station", "the sun", ili se koristi kod drugog spominjanja. Kod općih množina se izostavlja: "I like dogs."
gn.en.gn.art-the.title: the (osnovno)
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.note: Koristite "a" ispred suglasničkih glasova i "an" ispred samoglasničkih glasova: a book, an apple, an hour. Označava jednu, nespecifičnu stvar.
gn.en.gn.articles-a-an.title: a / an
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.note: "Am" ide uz I, a "are" uz you: "I am Anna. You are my friend." Ova dva oblika koristite za prva predstavljanja.
gn.en.gn.be-1sg-2sg.title: be: I am / you are
gn.en.gn.be-all.note: Am, is i are za sva lica: he, she i it koriste "is"; we, you i they koriste "are". "She is a doctor. They are from Peru."
gn.en.gn.be-all.title: be: cijeli prezent
gn.en.gn.be-neg.note: Dodajte "not" iza be: "I am not tired. She isn't here." Skraćeni oblici isn't i aren't zvuče najprirodnije u govoru.
gn.en.gn.be-neg.title: be: negacija
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.note: Prebacite be na početak: "You are tired." postaje "Are you tired?" Sam red riječi čini rečenicu upitnom — nije potrebna dodatna riječ.
gn.en.gn.be-yesno-q.title: Da/ne pitanja s be
gn.en.gn.can-ability.note: "I can swim. He can't drive." Jedan oblik za sva lica, a glagol iza njega ostaje u osnovnom obliku.
gn.en.gn.can-ability.title: can / can't (sposobnost)
gn.en.gn.can-request.note: "Can I have the menu? Can you help me?" — svakodnevna pristojna zamolba, za dopuštenje i usluge.
gn.en.gn.can-request.title: can (zamolbe)
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.note: Kratki pridjevi dobivaju -er i -est (older, the oldest); dugi koriste more i most. Good postaje better i best. Usporedite s "than": "My city is bigger than yours."
gn.en.gn.comp-superl.title: Komparativi i superlativi
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.note: Povežite ideje: "I like tea and coffee. It's small but nice. I stayed home because I was tired."
gn.en.gn.conn-basic.title: and / but / because
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.note: "This" pokazuje na nešto blizu vas, a "that" na nešto udaljenije: "This is my phone. That is your bag."
gn.en.gn.dem-sg.title: this / that
gn.en.gn.do-neg.note: "I don't know. She doesn't eat meat." Don't ili doesn't plus osnovni oblik glagola — -s se premješta na "does" i napušta glagol.
gn.en.gn.do-neg.title: Negacije s don't/doesn't
gn.en.gn.do-quest.note: "Do you like tea? Does she work here?" Do ili does započinje pitanje, a glavni glagol ostaje u osnovnom obliku.
gn.en.gn.do-quest.title: Pitanja s do/does
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.note: Engleski jezik zahtijeva subjekt čak i za vrijeme i vremenske prilike: "It is raining. It's cold. It's late." "It" ne pokazuje ni na što — samo popunjava mjesto subjekta.
gn.en.gn.dummy-it.title: it za vrijeme i vremenske prilike
gn.en.gn.going-to.note: Be plus going to plus glagol za planove: "I'm going to visit my aunt tomorrow. We're going to travel in June."
gn.en.gn.going-to.title: going to (planovi)
gn.en.gn.have-got.note: Posjedovanje: "I have two brothers. She has a car." Možete čuti i "have got" — tretirajte ga kao isto značenje.
gn.en.gn.have-got.title: have / has
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.note: "How many" s brojivim stvarima ("How many apples?") i "how much" s nebrojivim ("How much water?"). Za cijene se koristi "How much is it?"
gn.en.gn.how-much-many.title: How much / How many
gn.en.gn.imperatives.note: Recite nekome što da radi s osnovnim oblikom glagola: "Turn left. Wait here. Please don't stop." Dodavanje "please" čini rečenicu ljubaznijom.
gn.en.gn.imperatives.title: Imperativ
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.note: Glagol plus stvar, ništa između: "I like coffee. I want water." Osoba koja voli je subjekt.
gn.en.gn.like-want-noun.title: like / want + imenica
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.note: Brojite do sto i obratite pažnju na zamku -teen naspram -ty: thirteen i thirty zvuče slično, pa ih naglasak razlikuje.
gn.en.gn.numbers-1-100.title: Brojevi 1–100
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.note: Me, you, him, her, it, us, them — dolaze iza glagola: "Call me. I see her. Ask him."
gn.en.gn.obj-pron.title: Objektne zamjenice
gn.en.gn.past-be.note: Prošlo vrijeme glagola be: I, he, she i it koriste "was"; you, we i they koriste "were". "I was at home. They were happy."
gn.en.gn.past-be.title: was / were
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.note: Najčešći glagoli mijenjaju oblik u prošlom vremenu: go i went, have i had, see i saw, do i did, get i got, make i made.
gn.en.gn.past-irreg-top25.title: Nepravilni glagoli u prošlom vremenu (najčešći)
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.note: "Did you see it? I didn't go." Did nosi prošlo vrijeme, pa se glavni glagol vraća u osnovni oblik.
gn.en.gn.past-quest-neg.title: did: pitanja i negacije
gn.en.gn.past-reg.note: Dodajte -ed za završene radnje: "I worked. She visited her mother." Isti oblik vrijedi za sva lica.
gn.en.gn.past-reg.title: Past simple: -ed
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.note: Neke imenice mijenjaju oblik umjesto dodavanja -s: man i men, woman i women, child i children, person i people, foot i feet.
gn.en.gn.plural-irreg.title: Nepravilne množine
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.note: Dodajte -s za više od jednog, ili -es iza s, sh, ch i x: one cat, two cats; one box, two boxes.
gn.en.gn.plural-reg.title: Pravilne množine
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.note: My, your, his, her, its, our, their — stavite ih ispred imenice: "her book", "our house", "their names".
gn.en.gn.poss-adj.title: Posvojni pridjevi
gn.en.gn.poss-s.note: Dodajte 's vlasniku: "Anna's dog", "my brother's car". Engleski jezik stavlja vlasnika prvog, a posjedovanu stvar drugu.
gn.en.gn.poss-s.title: Posvojni 's
gn.en.gn.prep-place.note: In, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between — male riječi koje govore gdje: "The keys are on the table."
gn.en.gn.prep-place.title: Prijedlozi mjesta
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.note: Be plus verb-ing za sadašnji trenutak: "I am eating. They are working. Look, it is raining."
gn.en.gn.pres-cont.title: Present continuous
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.note: Uz he, she i it, glagol dobiva -s: "She works. He watches." To je slovo koje se najčešće zaboravlja u engleskom, pa mu posvetite posebnu pažnju.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-3sg.title: 3. lice -s
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.note: Za navike i činjenice, koristite osnovni oblik glagola: "I work at home. They live in Lima." Nema promjena završetaka za ove subjekte.
gn.en.gn.pres-simple-base.title: Present simple: I / you / we / they
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.note: I, you, he, she, it, we, they. Engleski jezik zahtijeva da se subjekt izgovori naglas u gotovo svakoj rečenici — "am tired" treba svoje "I".
gn.en.gn.pron-subject.title: Subjektne zamjenice
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.note: "I drink coffee every day" je navika; "I am drinking coffee" je ovaj trenutak. Vremenske riječi su vaš trag.
gn.en.gn.simple-vs-cont.title: Navika ili sadašnji trenutak?
gn.en.gn.some-any.note: "Some" u potvrdnim rečenicama ("I have some money") i "any" u niječnim i upitnim rečenicama ("Do you have any money?").
gn.en.gn.some-any.title: some / any
gn.en.gn.sv-order.note: Engleske rečenice slijede redoslijed Subjekt–Glagol–Objekt: "I eat apples." Redoslijed nosi značenje, stoga neka izvršitelj bude prvi, a radnja druga.
gn.en.gn.sv-order.title: Osnovni red riječi
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.note: Za reći da nešto postoji: "There is a bank. There are two cafes." Uskladite is ili are s brojem stvari koje mislite.
gn.en.gn.there-is-are.title: there is / there are
gn.en.gn.time-prep.note: "At" za točno vrijeme (at five), "on" za dane i datume (on Monday), "in" za mjesece, godine i dijelove dana (in May, in the morning).
gn.en.gn.time-prep.title: at / on / in za vrijeme
gn.en.gn.time-telling.note: Započnite s "It's": "It's three o'clock. It's half past two. It's seven fifteen." "It" ostaje iako ništa nije imenovano.
gn.en.gn.time-telling.title: Govorenje vremena
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.note: What, where, who ili how, zatim be, zatim subjekt: "Where are you? What is this? Who is that?"
gn.en.gn.wh-quest-be.title: Wh-pitanja s be
gn.en.gn.would-like.note: "I'd like a coffee, please" je pristojan način naručivanja ili traženja nečega — blaže od "I want".
gn.en.gn.would-like.title: I'd like (pristojno)
